options.misconception: multiplies the terms instead of solving for epsilon

questions.explanation: Rearranging Beer-Lambert law gives epsilon equals absorbance over path length times concentration. The logarithm reported here compresses the large value. Multiplying the terms or omitting path length does not isolate the molar absorptivity.
